ITEM 1 | Broccoli florets, bright to dark green with some darker charred tips, firm stems, clustered in the upper-left of the plate, covering roughly 25% of the plate's area, about 3-4 cm tall, dry surface with slight browning | 110
ITEM 2 | Breaded or crusted pieces of meat-like portion, tan-golden crust with dark specks (likely seasoning or pepper), arranged in three to four slices/chunks on the right side, covering roughly 25% of the plate, about 1.5-2.5 cm thick, firm with browned edges, some pinkish-red interior visible in one piece | 150
ITEM 3 | Green herb or vegetable garnish with thin stringy green strands and small leaves, scattered over and beside the crusted pieces in the center-right, covering roughly 5% of the plate, flat and lightly moist, bright green | 20
ITEM 4 | Red sauce or reddish pulp visible at the lower right edge beside the crusted pieces, small smear about 2 cm across, moist, glossy | 10
